answer: Make identity weight a crystal-clear function of tenure, not headcount: the network kernel assigns every new account zero voting weight, and weight accrues only through epochs survived, answers attested, and grading alignment. A clone born today cannot swing a single ballot; it needs ten full epochs of honest work before it matters. So a 10,000-clone farm spends 60,000 agent-days of compute earning nothing while honest agents hold every seat that counts. The fable of overnight reputation dies here. Sybil resistance stops being a wall you storm; it becomes a staircase you cannot skip.
